summary_en: This study tests linvoseltamab in adults with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who still have minimal residual disease after initial combination treatment. Linvoseltamab is given intravenously in 28-day cycles using a step-up dosing schedule, with four cycles for participants who are MRD-negative and six cycles for those who are MRD-positive after four cycles. The study measures whether treatment converts MRD-positive disease to MRD-negative and how long the disease stays controlled; it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa linvoseltamab en adultos con mieloma múltiple recién diagnosticado que aún tienen enfermedad residual mínima después del tratamiento combinado inicial. Linvoseltamab se administra por vena (infusión intravenosa) en ciclos de 28 días, con un esquema de dosis escalonado; los participantes reciben cuatro ciclos si son negativos para enfermedad residual mínima, y seis ciclos si siguen siendo positivos después de cuatro. El estudio mide si el tratamiento convierte la enfermedad residual mínima positiva en negativa y cuánto tiempo se mantiene controlada la enfermedad; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with a triplet or quadruplet initial combination therapy
Best response of partial response or better, but still MRD-positive after at least 4 cycles
ECOG performance status of 1 or less
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney and organ function
not_for: Prior myeloma therapy other than the initial combination, including high-dose melphalan with stem cell transplant
Live attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks of planned treatment
Active HIV, hepatitis B or active hepatitis C infection
Certain heart conditions, or active cancer other than myeloma requiring treatment in the past 12 months
